lines.1: Our teacher appeared without looking the least bit sorry.
lines.3: She's our homeroom teacher, and her subject is English.
lines.4: Being beautiful and well-endowed makes her an instant hit with the male students.
lines.5: She never acts coy and carries herself with an easygoing air--or an absent-minded one, if you're being uncharitable--so the girls like her, too.
lines.6: Oeyama is also the name of a place, which gets confusing, so everyone calls her Miss Inori.
lines.8: 「I was having tea in the faculty room, and before I knew it, it had gotten this late.」
lines.9: 「Well, you young punks don't know the meaning of patience. Waiting around once in a while is good experience. Consider it part of your education.」
lines.11: ...That was Mr. Tsuchinaga, the parrot perched on Inori's shoulder.
lines.12: He's Inori's pet. He usually flies around outside, but sometimes he accompanies her like this.
lines.13: 「Now then, let us begin homeroom. I'll hand out some forms, so please pass them along.」
lines.15: 「As second-years, you'll begin your career plans survey a little earlier in the year than you did as first-years. Please write down your dreams and hand the form in.」
lines.16: 「Listen up. You're already through with compulsory education. Anyone who doesn't continue their studies will soon have to brave the harsh seas of the real world.」
lines.17: 「Put those grated-yam brains to serious use for once and think about your future. Got it, you little brats?」
lines.20: 「It's all for the students' sake. Love hurts.」
lines.21: 「Grr... He sure says whatever he wants.」
lines.22: 「Still, Mr. Tsuchinaga is only a parrot.」
lines.23: 「Yeah. Can't do much about it when a parrot says it...」
lines.26: 「Let's stop somewhere and hang out on the way home!」
